name: type_conversions_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((SimpleWideningTest (mk-SimpleWideningTest (x Int)(y Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TypeCastTest (mk-TypeCastTest (pi Real)(truncated Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-SimpleWideningTest (sel-SimpleWideningTest SimpleWideningTest))
  (lift-TypeCastTest (sel-TypeCastTest TypeCastTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-SimpleWideningTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SimpleWideningTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SimpleWideningTest ((this Ref)) SimpleWideningTest
  (sel-SimpleWideningTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TypeCastTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TypeCastTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TypeCastTest ((this Ref)) TypeCastTest
  (sel-TypeCastTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-SimpleWideningTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SimpleWideningTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TypeCastTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TypeCastTest this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class SimpleWideningTest:
; -----------------------------------------

; --- getters for SimpleWideningTest.x: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-SimpleWideningTest this))
)

; --- getters for SimpleWideningTest.y: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest!y ((this Ref)) Real
  (y (deref-SimpleWideningTest this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class TypeCastTest:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for TypeCastTest.pi: ---

(define-fun TypeCastTest!pi ((this Ref)) Real
  (pi (deref-TypeCastTest this))
)

; --- getters for TypeCastTest.truncated: ---

(define-fun TypeCastTest!truncated ((this Ref)) Int
  (truncated (deref-TypeCastTest this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SimpleWideningTest:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SimpleWideningTest SimpleWideningTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SimpleWideningTest!x this) 42)
)

(assert (! (SimpleWideningTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SimpleWideningTest!y this) 3.5000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (SimpleWideningTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (SimpleWideningTest!x this) (* (SimpleWideningTest!y this) 20.0000000000000000))
)

(assert (! (SimpleWideningTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun SimpleWideningTest.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (SimpleWideningTest!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (SimpleWideningTest.inv4 1) :named _xkassert3))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TypeCastTest:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-TypeCastTest TypeCastTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TypeCastTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeCastTest!pi this) 3.1415900000000000)
)

(assert (! (TypeCastTest.inv1 2) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TypeCastTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeCastTest!truncated this) (to_int (TypeCastTest!pi this)))
)

(assert (! (TypeCastTest.inv2 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TypeCastTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeCastTest!truncated this) 3)
)

(assert (! (TypeCastTest.inv3 2) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-SimpleWideningTest const-1-SimpleWideningTest))
        2 (lift-TypeCastTest const-2-TypeCastTest))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-SimpleWideningTest () SimpleWideningTest
  (mk-SimpleWideningTest 42 (/ 7.0 2.0)))
(define-fun const-2-TypeCastTest () TypeCastTest
  (mk-TypeCastTest (/ 314159.0 100000.0) 3))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_real (x (sel-SimpleWideningTest (select heap 1)))))
      (a!2 (* (y (sel-SimpleWideningTest (select heap 1))) 20.0)))
  (< a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-SimpleWideningTest (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_int (pi (sel-TypeCastTest (select heap 2))))))
  (= (truncated (sel-TypeCastTest (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (x (sel-SimpleWideningTest (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (truncated (sel-TypeCastTest (select heap 2))) 3))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (y (sel-SimpleWideningTest (select heap 1))) (/ 7.0 2.0)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (pi (sel-TypeCastTest (select heap 2))) (/ 314159.0 100000.0)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              1
              (lift-SimpleWideningTest (mk-SimpleWideningTest 42 (/ 7.0 2.0))))
       2
       (lift-TypeCastTest (mk-TypeCastTest (/ 314159.0 100000.0) 3))))
